prompt: Render a finished high-fidelity DESKTOP WEBSITE SCREEN, landscape 1440 x 1000, not a poster. This is the EMU IT Club game stand at EMUCON 2026. Its layout is a FESTIVAL PROGRAMME adapted into a game launcher. Exact skeleton: narrow calm off-white institutional header containing original club identity left, complete official university signature right, tiny Türkçe | English selector. Below, two asymmetrical columns. Left 42 percent: one large amber printed-festival panel occupying the viewport height, dark ink huge condensed heading 'EMUCON 2026', then smaller 'IT CLUB', large warm headline 'OYUNA GEL.', one short sentence 'Bir oyun seç, bir tur dene.', and a SMALL original rocket from the supplied festival kit. A quiet baseline reads '24 EKİM · DAÜ STADYUMU'. No fabricated facts, numbers of clubs, times or rewards. No invented logos. This column is a coherent poster-derived piece but clearly part of the website. Right 58 percent: warm paper #f3efe6, short heading 'Ne oynamak istersin?' and three generously spaced horizontal selectable rows, each with a small real INTERFACE game preview at left, clear title in Big Shoulders Display, short Bricolage instructions and amber Oyna button at far right: Zero Point — 'Zamanı hisset.' — physical keyboard 'Boşluk'; Target Rush — 'Hedefleri yakala.' — Fare; Perfect Align — 'Tam çizgide dur.' — Boşluk. These three options dominate the right column, not marketing text. Lower down a quieter link index 'Diğer oyunlar': Snake · Brain Firewall · Myth or Fact · Digital Detective. Fine navy rules separate rows, squared controls, readable typography. Previews show a timing numeral 05.00, simple target circles, one alignment bar respectively. No random stock icons or fantasy characters. Supplied reference kit controls the palette and type: drum ink #121a2c, amber #de9e36, paper #f3efe6, coral #c85a53, original Big Shoulders Display and Bricolage Grotesque. The two original logo images are identity references only: retain whole signatures and proportions with clear space and flat calm background, no reinterpretation or circular crops. Keep original club mark as a complete small image, not a substituted icon. Subtle printed grain only on amber artwork, no torn-shape excess, no repeating stars or HUD. A beautiful professional real website game-selection experience with exact visible actions and concise Turkish text. The left programme makes the event recognizable; the right makes playing effortless.
notes: Concept only. Use actual unmodified original logos in implementation; generated signatures are not production assets. Use real supplied illustration source.
